accuracy.evidence: Checked for estm: 27→30, 25→30 (5-up), 28+34≈60; NC Y3 / CCSS 3.NBT.A.1 nearest ten and estimate sums.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked for estm: traps always-round-down; estimate must equal exact; leave-5-as-is; rounding only one addend.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked for estm: number-line round + midpoint + estimate sum; not flaginvadd (undo checks) or flagbundle (place-value rods).

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked for estm: learner picks 30 for 27 and 25, builds estimate 60, judges 60 low vs 62, states 5-up rule.

predictions.evidence: Checked for estm: wrong options 20 for 27, 20 for 25, 62 as estimate, high vs low, always-round-down.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked for estm: why() splits down/same/fifteen, exact/fifty, high/useless/must, leave/avoid — each corrects the slip.

readability.evidence: Checked for estm: ages 7–9 kid lines round/nearest ten/estimate; adult names ones digit and midpoint within FK bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked for estm: every sentence teaches rounding, names a slip, or describes a lab action — no template throat-clearing.

mobile.evidence: Checked for estm: young class, large choice buttons under the number line; fits phone width ~390 px.

accessibility.evidence: Checked for estm: buttons mirror canvas taps; live aria-label via say(); challenge status aria-live; axe clean both themes expected.

sources: NC Y3 / CCSS 3.NBT.A.1; round to nearest 10 and estimate sums
